question: Which physicist is best known for his experiments on generating and confirming the existence of electromagnetic waves?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Heinrich Rudolf Hertz.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Heinrich Rudolf Hertz conducted experiments that proved the existence of electromagnetic waves, predicted by James Clerk Maxwell.
 
• He demonstrated that** radio waves and light waves were both forms of electromagnetic waves.**
